reconstruction.maskMethod: Native binary cell mask from a registered white flash. Upper contour: 2862; uncropped lower contour: 2919. Smoke above row 40 is rejected.
reconstruction.closeupColorMethod: Central 50% means across 18 registered close-up frames. Joint native colors and two-endpoint saturation/black-level reveal separate compression bleed from animated grading; the white-flash alpha mask is preserved.

reconstruction.sampleMethod: Central 60% cell means from two calibrated plane projections, weighted by projected cell resolution.
Central 60% native-cell means from three registered repeats; higher-resolution observations take priority.
reconstruction.alphaMethod: Observed warm foreground and unobscured background; no silhouette closing or hole filling.
reconstruction.limitations: The faint final arc shares the last complete cloud projection; compressed and occluded contours remain approximate.
